comment: Princess Dress Up Room, Codex art pilot, plate A (idol teen). Every picture is a whole registered figure in the 1200 x 1800 frame (art/offsets.json: x, y, sourceWidth, sourceHeight). derive 'changed' keeps only the pixels that differ from rig.basePlate inside the layer's region (an accessory; renders also redraw hands and edges, so the region is required); derive 'patch' puts a doll's own head and hair over an outfit wherever the outfit left the base plate's pixels untouched. mask {auto: neutral} repaints the white/grey fabric below minY. Placeholder grey-box data: placeholder.json (?art=placeholder); plate B: plate-b.json (?plate=b).
